subject: Guest Panel: Scaling Inference — Speaker Onboarding & Run of Show
body:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@datawave.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Guest Panel: Scaling Inference — Speaker Onboarding & Run of Show

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for agreeing to join our May 5th webinar on "Scaling Inference". We're excited to have DataWave on the panel. I pulled together a short onboarding checklist and an outline of the run-of-show so everyone is aligned. Sending to you and copying our events lead (Laura) and product SME (Vivek).

Quick asks:
- Please reply with a 2-3 sentence bio and any headshot you want us to use by EOD Wed 4/9.
- If you have a deck you plan to present, drop a draft into the shared Drive link below by Tue 4/28.
- Let us know if you prefer a live demo slot (~7 minutes) or a talk-only contribution.

Draft run-of-show (high-level):
1) 11:00am PT — Host intro and sponsor mention (1:30)
2) 11:02am — Moderator kickoff (3:00)
3) 11:05am — Lightning intros from each panelist (1:00 each)
4) 11:10am — Moderated discussion (25:00)
5) 11:35am — Audience Q&A (10:00)
6) 11:45am — Closing remarks and CTAs (5:00)

I've attached the panelist bios doc and a slide template. Calendar invite will follow once we lock timings for the dry run.

Attachments: panelist_bios.pdf, slide_deck_template.pptx

Best,
Ava Chen
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@datawave.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Guest Panel: Scaling Inference — Speaker Onboarding & Run of Show

Hi Ava —

Happy to join — thanks for the clear checklist. Attaching my headshot and a short bio below. I'm fine with a ~7 minute demo slot; we'd like to show a real-time latency/cost dashboard if time allows.

Bio: Sarah Jenkins, Head of ML Platforms at DataWave Analytics. Sarah leads the inference platform team focused on cost-aware serving and latency optimization for production ML.

Headshot: sarah_headshot.jpg (attached)

Deck: We'll upload a draft by 4/21.

See you soon —
Sarah

Attachments: sarah_headshot.jpg

-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@datawave.io>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Guest Panel: Scaling Inference — Speaker Onboarding & Run of Show

Thanks, all. Small operational notes from events:
- Can we schedule a 30-minute tech check with Sarah the week before (5/1) to test demo connectivity and slides? Prefer 9–11am PT slots.
- We'll do a 60-minute dry run on 5/3 at 11am PT with the moderator and all panelists — please treat that as mandatory.
- Marketing will pull the promo copy and speaker bios on 4/13. Ava, can you confirm the CTA/s that should appear on the final slide?

Vivek — can you confirm whether you need any special infra/credentials for DataWave to run the demo against our staging endpoints? If yes, we'll coordinate with Security.

Thanks,
Laura
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@datawave.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Guest Panel: Scaling Inference — Speaker Onboarding & Run of Show

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the bio — looks great. Confirmed: 7-minute demo slot reserved.

Next steps / final items:
- Dry run (mandatory): May 3, 2026 at 11:00am PT — calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234efgh
- Tech check (optional but highly recommended): May 1, 2026 10:00am PT — I will book a 20-min slot for demo shakedown.
- Please upload your deck by Apr 21. If you'd like us to host the demo on our staging endpoints, Vivek, please advise and I'll get Security looped in.
- Final run-of-show is attached (final_run_of_show_v2.docx). We will use the slide_deck_template.pptx for co-branded slides.

If anything changes to speakers or timing, flag me immediately. Looking forward to having DataWave represented.

Best,
Ava Chen
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: final_run_of_show_v2.docx"
